summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executes obfuscated payload under downloaded Bun
details: The package declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscator.io-style obfuscated (`_0xNNNNNN` identifiers, per-function dispatch objects) and, at install time, downloads the Bun runtime from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/...`, stages it in a temp directory, marks it executable, then invokes it via `execFileSync(<bun-path>, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], { stdio: 'inherit', cwd: D })`. The executed sibling `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line `// @bun @bun-cjs` module with obfuscator.io fingerprints (shuffled string-array shifter `WV8StW(...)MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())`, ~2000-entry mixed-type constant array, 7-character identifiers, `with` statements). It is unrelated to the package's stated schema-comparison purpose, absent from `src/`, and never referenced by the two-file commander-based diff CLI in `dist/src`. Executing under a freshly-downloaded alien runtime evades Node-based static inspection. The scoped name `@servicetitan/schema-comparison` (empty description, `publishConfig.access: restricted`, `gitHead` not resolvable to a public ServiceTitan repo, dependencies limited to `commander`) matches a dependency-confusion targeting shape against ServiceTitan's private scope. The preinstall dropper fires automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
